hypotheses.R1_no_strict_spike_is_window_robust: The leading observed excess is non-positive in at least 80 percent of valid bulk-fit windows.
hypotheses.R2_relative_null_advantage_is_window_rob: Observed mean top-four excess exceeds every sign and pairing null in at least 75 percent of valid fit windows.
hypotheses.R3_top_singular_value_is_empirical_null_: The observed leading singular value exceeds every coordination-null leading singular value.
hypotheses.R4_all_top4_are_empirical_null_outliers: Each of the observed top four singular values exceeds every matched-rank coordination-null value.
hypotheses.R5_powerlaw_predicts_tail_better_than_ex: On alternating held-out ranks 33--1024, the power-law model has at least 10 percent lower log-spectrum RMSE than an exponential-rank model.
hypotheses.R6_top4_energy_exceeds_every_null: Observed top-four energy fraction exceeds every sign and pairing null replicate.
